data.title: First and last ERROR timestamp per service
data.description: Read the application log. Each line is "<timestamp> <LEVEL> <service> <message>", with timestamps in ISO 8601 UTC ("2026-03-04T11:02:10Z"). The log is not in chronological order. For every service with at least one line whose level is exactly "ERROR", find the earliest and the latest timestamp among its ERROR lines. Return "error_windows", a mapping of service to {"first": earliest, "last": latest}, with both timestamps copied exactly as written in the log; "services_with_errors", the number of such services; and "error_line_count", the total number of ERROR lines.
